about_the_game:
Yoko no Hanashi - is a first-person survival horror game where you need to survive in an abandoned college with one of your chosen yandere, while solving puzzles and collecting items that are unique to each antagonist. The task is to escape from college, or to gain yandere's favor and survive.

Yoto: A 20-year-old guy who goes to college with you. One day his gaze fell on you and since then you have become his addiction. He will do everything to make you belong to him.

Yoko: A mysterious girl who claims to know something about your father's death. You decide to go to a meeting with her after she throws you a note with the address, but you are ambushed.

Game Features:

  • Explore the college, study the history of Yandere, and solve any puzzles you encounter along the way

  • Unique interactions with yandere

  • 8 main endings and an unknown number of secret endings

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content that is not suitable for all ages or for viewing at work: Scenes of violence or cruelty, Adult content
